_note: The themes rulings accumulate against, and the thresholds that turn a pattern into a visible case history and then into offerable statute. Leaning accumulates invisibly at first — the player discovers they have a reputation rather than choosing one.

themes.name: Scarcity
themes.concerns: How shortages are distributed and who absorbs them

themes.name: Dissent
themes.concerns: How disagreement, theft, and disorder are answered

themes.name: Health
themes.concerns: What the Shaft asks of bodies, and what it spends to repair them

thresholds._note: Values here are the ones design-document §4 leaves as an open thread ('exact numbers'). These are a first pass: 2 consistent rulings to make a leaning visible, 3 to unlock codification.

flipFlop._note: Repeal penalty scaled to how long the law stood. Early experimentation is cheap; reversing entrenched law is risky.

promises._note: Promise timers are a gamble, not a free option. Meeting one makes the Trust gain permanent and sets keeps-promises, which strengthens future soft options. Missing one costs MORE than the harsh option would have, and sets broken-promise, which devalues every future promise.
